name: cam-local-capture
description: Reversible, auto-authorized-on-install, multi-instance local capture for NX and PowerMill operator logs.

interface.shortDescription: Capture multi-window CAM behavior locally with reversible authorization.
interface.longDescription: Adds local-only, redacted NX and PowerMill log capture with one-time authorization on installation, category-level advanced settings, per-window runtime status, source checkpoints, labels, export, revocation, and deletion controls.
interface.defaultPrompt: Explain how CAM Local Capture protects operator data.
